# HUD.gov

> > Official U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development website providing federal housing programs, FHA mortgage insurance, rental assistance, and affordable housing resources.

HUD.gov serves as the primary portal for accessing federal housing assistance programs including Housing Choice Vouchers, public housing, FHA-insured mortgages, and homeownership resources. The site provides policy guidance through HUDClips, property listings, and connections to data platforms like HUDExchange and HUDuser.gov.

## Key Topics

- FHA (Federal Housing Administration)
- Housing Choice Voucher Program
- Public Housing
- HUDClips (policy database)
- HUDExchange
- HUDuser.gov
- Ginnie Mae
- Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac
- CPD (Community Planning and Development)
- VAWA (Violence Against Women Act)
- Multifamily Housing
- Homeownership Assistance
- Rental Assistance
- Federal Property Sales
- Housing Data and Research

## Core Programs and Services

- [HUD Home](https://www.hud.gov/): U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development homepage
- [Programs of HUD](https://www.hud.gov/hudprograms): Directory of HUD housing assistance programs including CPD and VAWA
- [FHA and Housing Resources](https://www.hud.gov/fha): FHA mortgage insurance, homebuyer assistance, and lender resources
- [Homes for Sale](https://www.hud.gov/helping-americans/homes-for-sale): Federal property listings including HUD single & multifamily homes

## Policy and Reference

- [HUDClips](https://www.hud.gov/guidance): HUDCLIPS database of forms, handbooks, policies, and FHA regulations

## Support and Contact

- [Contact Us](https://www.hud.gov/contactus): HUD contact info, housing assistance help, and complaint reporting

## Optional

- [Site Map](https://www.hud.gov/siteindex): Complete site navigation index for HUD.gov resources and services
